verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing claims you can generate multiple versions at once, batch-produce videos, and automate production (kling-docs-7). Dedicated Skills generate assets in parallel (kling-docs-4), and an MCP/CLI lets agents drive Kling 'at scale' (kling-docs-8). This is the product's own batch-generation capability, but it is evidenced only by homepage marketing lines, and bulk operations over existing items are not documented. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions on existing items (batch edit, delete, download or re-run), a documented batch API endpoint or CLI batch command with limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
